metadata.title: Gated exciton fluids II: a machine-checked kernel theorem, a harmonic crystallisation estimate, open-boundary energies, a validity gate for materials-data inputs, and an exponential integrator that did not meet its gate
metadata.description: Second paper of the gated-exciton line (first: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23294615). Five pre-registered work packages, each re-checked by an independent hostile verifier before deposit. (1) Lean 4 / Mathlib formalisation (52 theorems, no sorry, standard axioms only) that the image-charge kernel of a dual-gated bilayer is the Laplace transform of a non-negative bounded density, hence completely monotone in r^2, with the Poisson summation derived rather than assumed; the verifier compiled it and recomputed the kernel by an independent image sum. It does not prove the (unrefereed, AI-generated) lattice-optimality theorem. (2) A harmonic Lindemann estimate of the crystallisation threshold calibrated on a quantum-Monte-Carlo control: a negative result (a rigid-exciton crystal needs d/a_M of about 49 or more; gates only raise it; two registered predictions on the control failed). (3) An open-boundary study of 65 classical N-particle configurations of three completely monotone kernels: negative, aspect-ratio-dependent edge energy, no clean boundary law, reduced numbers of starts, one earlier hexagon claim withdrawn. (4) A validity gate for Hugging Face / neural-network inputs that fails for the electron-hole separation and binding energy. (5) An ETDRK4 exponential integrator that fails its registered order-4 gate at the registered stiffness (stiff-order reduction), is 29 times faster than dense BDF to a stationary state, and has a step limit below the IMEX module's at high density. Two packages (matrix-free Newton-Krylov at 64x64, and a classical node-arrangement study with the Fenris-CMRR engine) were still running and are not reported. No comparison with experimental data; no claim about exciton Bose-Einstein condensation. Written by an AI system; checked by independent instances; not refereed.
metadata.notes: Standalone paper of the SocrateAI-Scientific-QuantumFluids programme, written by an AI system under the author's standing instructions. The source archive contains the whole exploration/exciton tree as committed, including the in-progress Krylov and Fenris-gated work packages, whose results are NOT claimed in the paper. rusty-SUNDIALS tag v11.6.0 (tree 996aaf0706e1, commit 5db8041).
